title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force Ultimate Addons for Elementor - Lite header-footer-elementor plugin versions up to 2.9.5. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of affected users. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
